apps.title: Apps
apps.never: Never: passwords or tokens of data sources, sessions, write access, data of other organizations.
apps.cap.rule: Always with the rights of the person using the app, read-only.
apps.runs: An app runs in the browser, in a sealed frame without network, without a process on the server.
apps.noneText: Server admins install apps under Plugins.
apps.blockHint: Its pages leave the navigation; its storage stays.
apps.pagesPending: These are the pages of the installed version; the new ones show after the approval.
